muddy.definitionKo: 진흙이나 반죽 등이 물기가 많아 부드럽게 진 느낌이 있다.
muddy.englishDescription: Mud, dough, etc., feeling wet and soft because it contains a large amount of water.

muddy.definitionKo: 더러운 물질이 섞여 깨끗하지 못하고 흐리다.
muddy.englishDescription: Being muddy, not clear, with a filthy substance added.

muddy.definitionKo: 순수한 것에 다른 것이 섞여 깨끗하지 않다.
muddy.englishDescription: A pure substance becoming unclear because it has had a foreign matter added to it.

muddy.definitionKo: 진흙이나 반죽 등이 물기가 많아 부드럽게 질다.
muddy.englishDescription: Mud, dough, etc., being wet and soft because it contains a large amount of water.

muddy.definitionKo: 진흙이나 반죽 등이 물기가 많아 부드럽게 질다.
muddy.englishDescription: Mud, dough, etc., being soft and wet because it contains a large amount of water.

mugwort.definitionKo: 어린잎은 먹고 다 자란 잎은 말려서 약으로 쓰는, 들에 나는 풀.
mugwort.englishDescription: A kind of herb growing in the field, whose young leaves are eaten and whose mature leaves are dried and used as a medicine.

multimedia.englishDescription: Various media for conveying information, image, sound, etc.

multimedia.definitionKo: 컴퓨터를 통하여 영상, 음성, 문자 등과 같은 다양한 정보 매체를 복합적으로 만든 장치나 소프트웨어의 형태.
multimedia.englishDescription: A type of computer device or software that combines such diverse information media as video, voice, and text.

mynah.definitionKo: 온몸이 검고 날개에 커다란 흰무늬가 있으며 사람의 말을 잘 흉내 내는 새.
mynah.englishDescription: A black bird with a big white pattern on its wings, which imitates human speech.

neutral.definitionKo: 어느 한쪽에 치우치지 않고 중간 입장에 서는. 또는 그런 태도를 취하는.
neutral.englishDescription: Standing in the middle without being biased towards either side. Or taking such an attitude.

neutral.definitionKo: 서로 반대되는 두 성질 사이의 중간적 성질을 띠는.
neutral.englishDescription: Having a neutral quality that does not belong to either side of two conflicting qualities.

newest.definitionKo: 가장 새로움. 또는 가장 앞서 있음.
newest.englishDescription: Being the newest, or the most advanced.

no.definitionKo: 윗사람이 묻는 말에 대하여 부정하며 대답할 때 쓰는 말.

no.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when answering negatively in an emphatic and resolute manner.

no.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker gives a negative answer to a question asked by his/her elder or superior.

no.definitionKo: 아랫사람이나 나이나 지위 등이 비슷한 사람이 물어보는 말에 대해 부정하여 대답할 때 쓰는 말.
no.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker gives a negative answer to the question asked by his/her junior or someone of a similar age or position.
An exclamation uttered when the speaker feels dissatisfied or uneasy.

no.definitionKo: 어떤 사실에 대해 확인을 요구할 때 쓰는 말.
no.englishDescription: An exclamation used when asking someone to confirm something.

noise.englishDescription: (figurative) The act of making a noise about something out of surprise or excitement.

noise.definitionKo: 물체가 진동하여 생긴 음파가 귀에 들리는 것.
noise.englishDescription: Sound wave heard by the ear that is created when an object vibrates.

noise.definitionKo: 전화기나 라디오 등에서 나는, 귀에 거슬리는 좋지 못한 소리.
noise.englishDescription: A sound unpleasant to the ear that comes out of the telephone or radio.

nomad.definitionKo: 소나 양과 같은 가축이 먹을 풀과 물을 찾아 옮겨 다니면서 사는 민족.
nomad.englishDescription: People who roam to places to find grass and water for livestock such as cows and sheep.

nope.definitionKo: 묻는 말에 대하여 강조하며, 또는 단호하게 부정하며 대답할 때 쓰는 말.
nope.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when answering negatively in an emphatic and resolute manner.

nope.definitionKo: 아랫사람이나 나이나 지위 등이 비슷한 사람이 물어보는 말에 대해 부정하여 대답할 때 쓰는 말.
nope.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker gives a negative answer to the question asked by his/her junior or someone of a similar age or position.

notes.definitionKo: 책의 첫머리에 그 책을 읽는 데 필요한 참고 사항을 설명한 글.
notes.englishDescription: Explanatory notes necessary to read a certain book, appearing at its introduction.

nyang.englishDescription: (archaic) A bound noun that serves as a unit for counting money.
A bound noun that serves as a unit for measuring the weight of precious metals or herbal medicine.

ordinary.englishDescription: Something being not special because it is a part of daily life.
Not coming under a certain professional or special area.

ordinary.definitionKo: 수준이 보통에 가깝거나 정도나 형편이 기준에서 크게 벗어나지 않는 상태이다.
ordinary.englishDescription: The level of something being near an average, or a degree or situation being not far from a standard.
Being in an ordinary state, with nothing excellent or special.

ostrich.definitionKo: 다리와 목이 길고 날지는 못하지만 잘 달리는 큰 새.
ostrich.englishDescription: A big bird which cannot fly but which runs fast, with a long neck and long legs.

outdoors.englishDescription: The area outside a house or building.

outpatient.definitionKo: 환자가 병원에 입원하지 않고 다니면서 치료를 받음. 또는 그런 환자.
outpatient.englishDescription: The act of visiting a hospital for treatment without being hospitalized or a patient who does so.

paints.definitionKo: 색채가 있고 물이나 그 밖의 액체에 녹지 않는 고운 가루.
paints.englishDescription: Fine powder that has color and does not dissolve in water or other liquids.

pat-pat.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a hard object is hit lightly.

pat-pat.definitionKo: 단단한 물건을 계속해서 가볍게 두드리는 소리.
pat-pat.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a hard object keeps being hit lightly.

perceptivity.englishDescription: The ability of understanding the logic of things.

persuade.definitionKo: 상대방이 그 말을 따르거나 이해하도록 잘 설명하거나 타이르다.
persuade.englishDescription: To explain or persuade so that a person would understand or do as asked.

persuade.definitionKo: 상대방이 알아듣도록 말하여 이해시키거나 그렇다고 인정하게 하다.
persuade.englishDescription: To make a person understand or acknowledge a fact by explaining.

persuade.definitionKo: 잘 알아듣도록 자상하고 조리 있게 말해 주다.
persuade.englishDescription: To say something kindly and logically in order to get someone to understand and agree.

persuade.definitionKo: 상대방이 알아듣도록 말하여 이해시키거나 그렇다고 인정하게 하다.
persuade.englishDescription: To make a person understand or acknowledge a fact by explaining.

philosophical.englishDescription: Being based on or related to philosophy.

photosynthesis.definitionKo: 녹색 식물이 태양 에너지를 이용하여 이산화 탄소와 수분으로 유기물을 만들어 내는 과정.
photosynthesis.englishDescription: The process of a green plant making organic matter with carbon dioxide and water through solar energy.

pickles.definitionKo: 오이, 양배추 등의 채소나 과일 등을 식초, 설탕, 소금, 향신료를 섞어 만든 액체에 담아 절여서 만든 음식.
pickles.englishDescription: Food made by preserving fruits or vegetables including cucumbers, cabbage, etc., in a liquid mixture of vinegar, sugar, salt, spice, etc.

pickpocketing.definitionKo: 남의 주머니나 가방에서 돈이나 물건을 몰래 훔치는 짓.
pickpocketing.englishDescription: The act of stealing money or objects from other people's pockets or bags.

pierce.englishDescription: To push one's way through an obstacle.

pierce.definitionKo: 깊이 연구하여 그 분야의 이치나 진리를 깨닫다.
pierce.englishDescription: To realize the truth or secrets of learning by studying deeply.
To guess what someone thinks, or predict the future.

pierce.definitionKo: 한쪽에서 다른 한쪽으로 뚫어 구멍이 나다.

To make a hole from this way to that way.
(figurative) To make someone feel painful or hurt.

pierce.definitionKo: 끝이 뾰족하거나 날카로운 것으로 어떤 것의 겉면이 뚫어지거나 쑥 들어가도록 세차게 들이밀다.
pierce.englishDescription: To push something hard with a pointed or sharp object to penetrate or dent it.

pierce.definitionKo: 날카로운 소리나 세찬 움직임 등이 어떤 대상을 가르다.
pierce.englishDescription: For a sharp sound, violent movement, etc., to go through something.
To make someone feel pain or to hurt that person in a figurative sense.

pitcher.definitionKo: 야구에서, 상대편의 타자가 칠 공을 포수를 향해 던지는 선수.
pitcher.englishDescription: In baseball, a player who throws a ball, which a hitter might hit with a bat, toward a catcher.

plagiarism.definitionKo: 글, 노래 등을 지을 때 다른 사람의 작품의 일부를 몰래 따와서 씀.
plagiarism.englishDescription: An act of secretly taking and using a part of someone's work when composing a piece of writing, a song, etc.

poem.definitionKo: 글쓴이의 생각과 느낌을 리듬이 있는 형식으로 나타낸 문학 작품.
poem.englishDescription: A literary work that expresses the writer's thoughts and feelings in a rhythmical format.

poem.definitionKo: 글쓴이의 생각과 느낌을 리듬이 있는 글의 형식으로 나타낸 문학.
poem.englishDescription: A literary work that expresses the writer's thoughts and feelings in a rhythmical format.

poop-poop.definitionKo: 막혀 있던 공기나 가스가 조금 큰 구멍으로 빠져나갈 때 잇따라 나는 소리.
poop-poop.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made repeatedly when the air or gas sealed in something gets out through a rather large hole.

ppajida.definitionKo: 앞에 오는 말의 성질이나 상태가 아주 심하여 못마땅함을 나타내는 말.
ppajida.englishDescription: An auxiliary adjective used to indicate that the speaker is displeased because the quality or state described by the preceding words is very deteriorating or dismal.

praise.definitionKo: 어떤 사람을 지나치게 칭찬해서 우쭐하게 하다.
praise.englishDescription: To praise someone too much, making him/her feel proud.

praise.definitionKo: 좋은 점이나 잘한 일 등을 매우 훌륭하게 여기는 마음을 말로 나타내다.

praise.definitionKo: 뛰어난 업적이나 본받을 만한 정신, 위대한 사람 등을 칭찬하고 기억하다.
praise.englishDescription: To compliment and remember a notable achievement, exemplary spirit, great man, etc.

praise.definitionKo: 좋은 점이나 잘한 일 등을 매우 훌륭하게 여기는 마음을 말로 나타냄. 또는 그런 말.
praise.englishDescription: An act of expressing one’s appreciation of someone’s strength or achievement, etc., or such a remark.

praise.definitionKo: 아름답고 훌륭한 것 등을 높여 말하며 칭찬함.

praise.definitionKo: 아름답고 훌륭한 것 등을 높여 말하며 칭찬하다.
praise.englishDescription: To speak highly of something beautiful or great.

praise.englishDescription: Words or a piece of writing that expresses one's admiration for someone or something.

praise.definitionKo: 아름답고 훌륭함을 드러내어 크게 기리고 칭찬함.
praise.englishDescription: An act of honoring and complimenting the beauty and greatness of something or someone.

praise.englishDescription: To honor and compliment the beauty and greatness of something or someone.

praise.definitionKo: 아름답고 훌륭한 덕행을 기리고 칭찬함.
praise.englishDescription: An act of honoring and complimenting a beautiful, great virtue.

praise.definitionKo: 아름답고 훌륭한 덕행을 기리고 칭찬하다.
praise.englishDescription: To honor and compliment a beautiful, great virtue.

praise.definitionKo: 칭찬하며 감탄함.
praise.englishDescription: An expression of admiration and awe.

praise.definitionKo: 칭찬하며 감탄하다.
praise.englishDescription: To admire and be in awe of.

praise.definitionKo: 다른 사람을 칭찬함. 또는 그런 말.
praise.englishDescription: An act of praising someone, or such a remark.

praise.definitionKo: 다른 사람을 칭찬하다.

praise.englishDescription: An act of expressing one's gratitude or praising someone.

praise.englishDescription: An act of mentioning a very admirable, great aspect of someone, or such a mention.

praise.englishDescription: An act of praising someone for his/her excellence or achievement; or an act of giving a certificate, medal, etc., to praise someone.

praise.englishDescription: To praise someone for his/her excellence or achievement; or to give a certificate, medal, etc., to praise someone.

presider.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 중심이 되어 맡아 처리하는 사람.

prevalent.definitionKo: 유행, 사상, 세력 등이 빠르게 퍼져서 걷잡을 수가 없다.
prevalent.englishDescription: A fashion, ideology, force, etc., spreading fast and thus being uncontrollable.

proceedings.definitionKo: 여럿이 모여 의논한 내용, 진행 과정, 결과 등을 적은 기록.
proceedings.englishDescription: A written record of the discussion, progress, and outcome of a meeting.

proposer.englishDescription: A person who presents his/her opinion or suggests an agenda item.

prosecution.definitionKo: 검사가 법원에 형사 사건의 재판을 청구함.
prosecution.englishDescription: The act of a prosecutor requesting a trial for a criminal case to the court.

prosecution.definitionKo: 법률에서, 검사가 특정한 형사 사건에 대해 법원에 심판을 요청함.
prosecution.englishDescription: In law, a prosecutor requests the court to make a judgment on a specific criminal case.

prosecution.definitionKo: 형사 사건에 대해, 법원에 심판을 신청하여 이를 수행하는 일.
prosecution.englishDescription: In a criminal case, an act of applying for a trial and carrying it out at a courthouse.

proverb.englishDescription: A short phrase with a lesson that descends from the people of the old times.

proverb.definitionKo: 오랜 시간 동안 사람들 사이에서 전해지는 인생에 대한 교훈이나 경계 등을 간결하게 표현한 말.

publicly.englishDescription: So that something is open to the public, without being hidden or held back.

push-up.definitionKo: 두 손바닥과 발끝으로 몸을 받치고 곧게 뻗쳐 엎드린 자세에서 짚은 팔을 굽혔다 폈다 하는 운동.

quiveringly.definitionKo: 춥거나 무서워서 몸을 계속해서 떠는 모양.
quiveringly.englishDescription: A word describing the movement of one's body quivering continuously with cold or fear.

quiveringly.definitionKo: 작고 가볍게 조금 떠는 소리. 또는 그 모양.

quiveringly.englishDescription: In the state of keeping shivering with cold, fear, or anger.

quiveringly.definitionKo: 춥거나 무서워서 몸을 계속 심하게 떠는 모양.
quiveringly.englishDescription: In the state of continuously trembling severely because one is cold or scared.

quiveringly.definitionKo: 가볍게 조금 떠는 소리. 또는 그 모양.

A word describing the movement of shivering lightly and slightly.

quiveringly.definitionKo: 몸을 자꾸 크게 부르르 떠는 모양.
quiveringly.englishDescription: In a state of one's body shivering severely and continuously.
A word describing the motion of shivering with large, light movements.

rationalize.definitionKo: 낭비를 없애고 경제적이고 효율적으로 체제를 개선하다.
rationalize.englishDescription: To minimize waste and improve a system so that it becomes more economical and efficient.

rationalize.definitionKo: 현실로 되다. 또는 현실에 맞게 만들다.
rationalize.englishDescription: To become real or to make something real.

ray.englishDescription: A word that means a beam of light.

ray.definitionKo: 몸이 넓적한 마름모꼴이고 꼬리가 가늘고 긴 바닷물고기.
ray.englishDescription: Flat-bodied, diamond-shaped marine fish with a long thin tail.

ray.definitionKo: 밝은 물체에서 뻗어 나오는 빛. 또는 그 빛의 줄기.
ray.englishDescription: Ray that shoots out from a bright object, or the streak of light from it.

ray.definitionKo: 해, 볕, 불 또는 흐르는 물 등의 내비치는 기운.
ray.englishDescription: The strong energy of the sun, sunshine, fire, flowing water, etc.

ray.definitionKo: 빛이나 불, 물 등이 길게 뻗어 나가는 모양.
ray.englishDescription: The manner in which a light, fire, stream, etc., runs long.

ray.definitionKo: 빛이나 물, 연기 등이 길게 뻗어 나가는 것을 세는 단위.
ray.englishDescription: A unit of counting lights, fires, streams, etc., that run or thrust.

recognition.definitionKo: 많은 사람들의 관심 또는 사회적 주목과 인기.
recognition.englishDescription: Social attention and being well-liked by many people.

recognition.definitionKo: 어떤 사실을 확실히 그렇다고 여겨서 앎.
recognition.englishDescription: An act of knowing a certain fact by becoming certain about it.
